assets.source: Kenney Nature Kit 2.1, https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit. log.glb, unchanged

assets.description: A debarked log: the log shape from the "logs" asset, pale because its bark is gone, with faint lengthwise drawknife streaks, a few bark scraps near the ends, darker knots, and cut ends that darken towards the middle. Shown lying on the ground and on the player's shoulder.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: Bark: a HUD line icon of one peeled strip with its end rolled into a curl, shown beside bark in the backpack, on the "Add bark" button, and on the debarking bar. Bark never lies on the ground yet, so it has no 3D shape.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: The foundation: four debarked logs laid side by side over one building-grid square, resting on two cross beams with a leg under each end. Each deck log differs a little in thickness, length, and turn, and the logs and beams show darker cut ends. The legs reach down to the ground, so they grow longer on the low side of a slope. As a blueprint it shows see-through, each delivered log waits pale and half solid in its place, and construction lays the logs one per stage after the legs and beams go in.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: The log wall: a 2 m stack of debarked logs laid along one edge of a foundation square. Each delivered log is cut in two, so each build stage lays two courses. As a blueprint it shows see-through, each delivered log waits pale and half solid in its place, and construction lays the courses from the bottom up. A finished wall between the camera and the player fades out.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: The door frame: two debarked-log posts on one edge of a foundation square, with a lintel across the top, 2 m tall. The doorway stays open. As a blueprint it shows see-through, each delivered log waits pale and half solid in its place, and construction puts up the left post, the right post, then the lintel. A finished frame between the camera and the player fades out.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: The cabin roof section: a sloped roof over one foundation square, resting on the tops of its walls. It slopes 12 degrees down to the front to shed rain, and sections one behind another share one continuous slope. Three faceted debarked-log rafters with pale cut ends rest on the front wall. Where a section has no section beside or behind it, debarked logs stacked on the wall, cut to the slope, fill the gap up to the bark. Four strips of bark, made like the lean-to's but pressed flatter, trimmed neater, and painted with a grain of streaks, cracks, and knots, lie over them like shingles from the front up, a little past the square's edges. As a blueprint it shows see-through, each delivered log waits pale and half solid in its place, and construction puts up the rafters one per stage, then lays the bark one strip per stage. The roof above the player hides when they stand under it.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: The chest: a rough box hewn from debarked logs, 0.9 m wide and 0.55 m deep. Its body is thick pale planks with cut ends showing, and its lid is three planks laid side by side with a small overhang. As a blueprint it shows see-through, each delivered log waits pale and half solid in its place, and construction builds the body in the first stage and puts on the lid in the second.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: Firewood: one quarter of a log, split lengthwise, with bark on the round face and pale split wood. Nothing draws it in the world yet.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: The campfire: a ring of uneven stones, a cone of sticks, and a bed of ash.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: The lean-to: two crooked front posts with forked tops, a ridge pole resting in the forks, and crooked stick rafters sloping to the ground at the back. Curled strips of bark, dark outside and pale inside with ragged lower edges, cover the rafters like shingles. The front is open. It is built in stages: each stick, then each strip of bark, fades in and is lowered into place.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.source: KayKit Character Pack: Adventurers 1.0 by Kay Lousberg, https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-adventurers (also https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0). assets.description: A campfire built as a person builds one: first the stones drop into place one by one round the ring. Then each stick is held at its lean above its place, lowered straight down, and set down, without turning or bouncing. The ash spreads out at the end.
assets.source: Built in code in this project

assets.description: Coloured filled icons for every kind of thing in the backpack, shown in the HUD's backpack chips: axe, knife, drawknife, fire striker, bedroll, stick, firewood, bark, berries, mushroom, and the pot when empty, holding river water, or holding boiled water. Each item has its own shape, a main colour, and an accent colour, such as a wooden handle on a steel blade. The item's name shows when the player points at its chip.

Bark, berries, mushrooms, and tools are rough shapes.
